errorCodes.usage-missing-argument: A required argument or flag value was absent. Supply it.
errorCodes.usage-unknown-command: The command or subcommand does not exist. Check the spelling against --help.
errorCodes.usage-unknown-option: The command does not take an option that was given. Check the spelling against --help, or run Git for Git's own option.
errorCodes.usage-conflicting-options: Two options that cannot be combined were both given. Choose one.
errorCodes.usage-invalid-option-value: An option value was outside its accepted set or range. Choose a permitted value.
errorCodes.not-found: The named forecast, workspace, commit, file, or envelope does not exist. Check the identifier.
errorCodes.already-exists: The destination path or ref already exists. Choose another, or remove the existing one deliberately.
errorCodes.no-match: The named item exists but is not a candidate for this operation. List the candidates and choose again.
errorCodes.ambiguous-match: Several candidates matched and none was selected. Name one explicitly.
errorCodes.nothing-pending: There is nothing of this kind pending in this worktree. No action is required.
errorCodes.malformed-input: A document or record could not be parsed, or failed a structural check. Repair or regenerate it.
errorCodes.invalid-identifier: An identifier does not have the required form. Check it against the published identity profile.
errorCodes.unsafe-input: An argument contained a character that is not safe to pass to Git. Remove it.
errorCodes.path-outside-repository: A path escaped the repository root. Give a path inside the repository.
errorCodes.integrity-check-failed: A declared hash did not match the bytes it covers. The artifact was altered or truncated.
errorCodes.store-corrupt: A native repository's store does not match its published contract (docs/native-store/). Stop and surface this to a human; import the repository again.
errorCodes.unknown-schema-version: A record's schema version is outside what this build reads. Read it with the build that wrote it.
errorCodes.wrong-record-family: A store held a record of a different family than expected. Stop and surface this to a human.
errorCodes.resource-bound-exceeded: An input exceeded a published resource bound. Reduce the input, or raise the bound deliberately.
errorCodes.no-common-version: Two builds share no version of a family, profile, or algorithm an exchange needs. Upgrade one side; nothing is wrong with either record.
errorCodes.dirty-worktree: The worktree has uncommitted changes and this operation requires a clean one.
errorCodes.precondition-not-met: A stated precondition does not hold yet. The message names the step that establishes it.
errorCodes.operation-in-progress: A causet operation journal is present in an affected worktree. Finish or abort it first.
errorCodes.notes-locked: Another causet process holds the causal notes lock. Wait for it to finish and retry; remove the lock file only if that process is gone.
errorCodes.workspace-registry-locked: The workspace registry lock could not be acquired. Retry after the holder finishes; recover an abandoned lock only with all workspace writers stopped on every host sharing the repository.
errorCodes.no-operation-pending: No causet operation is pending, so there is nothing to continue or abort.
errorCodes.operation-state-invalid: The pending operation is in a state this command cannot act on. The message names the state.
errorCodes.git-operation-active: Git itself has a replay or sequencer operation in progress. Resolve it before continuing.
errorCodes.out-of-band-change: Git's state and the causet journal disagree, because Git was driven directly. Abort and restart the operation.
errorCodes.repository-mismatch: The named path or object belongs to a different repository or workspace than the one in use.
errorCodes.unmigrated-repository: The repository keeps its metadata under the names used before causet, which this build no longer reads. Run cst migrate; it deletes nothing.
errorCodes.stale-forecast: A forecast no longer matches the repository it was pinned to. Regenerate and re-approve it.
errorCodes.stale-overlay: The worktree changed since its target overlay was captured. Capture a new checkpoint and forecast again; nothing was re-captured for you.
errorCodes.stale-input: An input changed while the operation was running. Retry from a quiet repository.
errorCodes.stale-manifest: A specification manifest no longer matches the Markdown it describes. Re-index it with cst spec index, then stage or commit the result.
errorCodes.conflict-paused: The operation paused on a conflict and is resumable. Resolve the paths, then continue.
errorCodes.interactive-paused: A declared interactive action paused the rebase for the caller to supply a message or change content. Continue when ready; nothing was lost.
errorCodes.conflict-blocked: Git could not apply or continue the change. The details carry Git's own output.
errorCodes.approval-required: The plan contains heuristic candidates that must be accepted explicitly before proceeding.
errorCodes.manual-review-required: A semantic merge could not be decided conservatively and needs a human.
errorCodes.identity-not-preserved: A rewrite did not carry the logical identity it was required to preserve (FR-ID-02).
errorCodes.identity-conflict: Two records claim the same identifier with different content. Resolve the conflict before importing.
errorCodes.git-unavailable: Git could not be started at all. Check that it is installed and on PATH.
errorCodes.git-command-failed: A Git command exited non-zero. The details carry its output.
errorCodes.path-length-exceeded: Git could not create a resolution retention ref at the Windows path-length limit. Shorten the Git directory path or enable Git long paths, then retry.
errorCodes.revision-not-resolved: A revision or object did not resolve to the expected type. Check the reference.
errorCodes.git-response-malformed: Git returned output this build could not parse. Report it with the Git version.
errorCodes.session-unavailable: A batched Git session is closed, timed out, or failed. The command falls back to ordinary Git where it can.
errorCodes.unsupported-feature: The prototype does not implement this case. The message names the supported set.
errorCodes.unsupported-repository-shape: The repository's history or object format is outside what this operation supports.
errorCodes.unsupported-range: The named commit range is not one this operation can execute. The message says which rule it broke; name a range from an ancestor up to a branch tip.
errorCodes.unavailable-in-native-repository: The command is not implemented in a native repository, which has no Git to pass it to. The message names the native command that does the job, when there is one.
errorCodes.internal-invariant: An internal invariant did not hold. This is a defect; report it.
